skills.name: Swallow Soul
skills.description:
Steal an enemy's life force, dealing |cffffff13105|r Magic Damage and healing you for |cffffff35|r% of the damage inflicted every |cffffff2|r seconds for |cffffff10|r seconds.

Deals |cffffff1|r% more damage for every |cffffff2|r% Health you have.

skills.name: Crystal Fragments
skills.description:
Conjure dark crystals to bombard an enemy, dealing |cffffff12058|r Magic Damage. Your next non-Ultimate ability cast within |cffffff3|r seconds costs |cffffff10|r% less.

While slotted on either bar, casting a non-Ultimate ability has a |cffffff33|r% chance of causing your next Crystal Fragments to be instant cast at half cost, dealing |cffffff20016|r Magic Damage.

skills.name: Hardened Ward
skills.description:
Conjure globes of Daedric energy for protection, granting a damage shield for you and your pets that absorbs |cffffff14353|r damage for |cffffff6|r seconds.

This ability scales off the higher of your Max Health or Magicka and the shield is capped at |cffffff72|r% of your Max Health.

skills.name: Summon Unstable Clannfear
skills.description:
Command the powers of Oblivion to send a Daedric clannfear to fight at your side. The clannfear's headbutt deals |cffffff1746|r Physical Damage, while its tail spike hits nearby enemies for |cffffff1835|r Physical Damage after |cffffff1|r second.  

Once summoned, you can activate the clannfear's special ability for |cffffff3499|r Magicka, healing you for |cffffff6700|r and the clannfear for |cffffff3349|r.

The clannfear remains until killed or unsummoned.

skills.name: Inner Light
skills.description:
Conjure a mote of magelight, revealing stealthed and invisible enemies around you for |cffffff7|r seconds. Exposed enemies cannot return to stealth or invisibility for |cffffff4|r seconds. The light is so brilliant that you cannot conceal your presence while active.

While slotted gain Major Savagery, increasing Critical Chance by |cffffff12|r% and your Max Magicka is increased by |cffffff5|r%.

skills.name: Swarming Scion
skills.description:
Transform into a monstrous creature of the night, instantly healing to full Health.

While transformed, your Max Health, Magicka, and Stamina are increased by |cffffff10000|r, you heal for |cffffff16|r% of all damage you deal, and you can see enemies through walls. 

Bats also swarm around you and shred enemies that come close, dealing |cffffff3798|r Magic Damage every |cffffff1|r second.
